data.one_liner: Flutter extension for Fimber logging API to use native OS logging via platform channels.
data.what_it_does: It extends the Fimber logging API for Flutter applications, enabling the use of native OS logging statements through platform channels. It is provided as a plugin supporting Android and iOS.
use_when: You are already using Fimber and need native OS logging integration in a Flutter app
You want to route logs to native Android and iOS logging systems
avoid_when: You are not using the Fimber logging ecosystem
You only require standard Dart console printing
strengths: Works alongside the Fimber logging API
weaknesses: Limited documentation in the provided materials
Requires platform-specific implementation code for Android and iOS
data.setup_notes: Not documented beyond standard Flutter plugin setup for Android and iOS.
